psvIntro.intro: PSV is the process of confirming your academic qualification directly with the issuing university. The UAE Ministry of Higher Education & Scientific Research (MOHESR) requires PSV before issuing an equivalency or recognition certificate for any degree earned outside the UAE.

uaePass.intro: To simplify your application process and obtain MOHESR recognition, you must have a UAE Pass. Ensure the following pass details are accurate, as they will automatically populate your Helloverify application:
uaePass.footer: Applicants can register by downloading the UAE Pass app from the App Store or Google Play. All individuals, whether overseas visitors, residents, or locals, can obtain the UAE Pass.

checklist: You must upload your Final Degree Certification and a Full-Year Mark Sheet or Transcript that covers your entire study period, including the courses taken and grades received.
All documents must be in PDF or JPEG format and under 10MB.
If your documents are in a language other than English or Arabic, you must provide a legal translation into one of these languages.
Valid and clear passport copy (front and back)

appealProcess.title: Appeal Process
paragraphs: If your report states "Unable to Verify" or "Discrepancy," you cannot proceed to Stage 2 of your Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research application for the final recognition certificate, as your verification report has not met MOHESR requirements.
If you believe the outcome of the verification is inaccurate, contact our support team at appeal.mohesr@helloverify.ae to confirm your eligibility for a one-time, free-of-charge appeal.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Common questions about MOHESR primary source verification with HelloVerify.

items.question: How do I create a UAE PASS?
items.answer: You can create your UAE Pass by visiting https://www.uaepass.ae/ where you can find instructions and the QR code to download the application.

items.question: How does the Helloverify Group assist with the recognition of qualifications process for the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHESR)?
items.answer:
The Helloverify Group is an **authorized verification partner** for the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHESR), providing essential education verification services for Recognition applications.
Through this service, Helloverify validates and verifies your documents, which allows you to proceed to the second stage of the recognition process and obtain the official **Certificate of Recognition** for your international qualification directly from MOHESR.

items.question: How and where can I pay for the service?
items.answer: Payment is the final step within the Helloverify portal. Once you have completed the online application and uploaded all your documents, you will be directed to the MOHESR payment gateway. Upon successful payment, a receipt will be sent to your registered email address.

items.question: How do I edit my personal details?
items.answer: We obtain your personal information directly from your UAE Pass. If you want to change any details, please update them in your UAE Pass profile before submitting your application. The corrected details will then be reflected in your Helloverify portal when you submit your application.

items.question: Which documents do I need to submit for verification for MOHESR recognition through Helloverify?
items.answer:
The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHESR) in the UAE is the official authority that evaluates and approves educational qualifications to match UAE standards. To know about the document requirements, visit this link:
https://www.mohesr.gov.ae/en/EServices/ServiceCard/pages/UniversiyCertificateEquilization.aspx

items.question: Is document attestation or stamping required prior to submitting my documents for verification?
items.answer: No special attestation or stamping is required on your documents for the recognition process with Helloverify or MOHESR. You only need to submit clear scanned copies of the original documents as received from your university/institution.

items.question: Why is the Legal Translation of Transcript/Degree option mandatory for me when my Transcript/Degree is already in English or Arabic?
items.answer: If your document is available in English or Arabic, please return to the "Education Detail" section and choose "Yes" for the question: "Are your degree and transcripts in English or Arabic. This step will allow you to proceed without a translation.

items.question: Can I add an additional certificate to my existing Helloverify application?
items.answer:
Yes, you can upload any supporting documents in the additional documents section.
However, if you want to apply for multiple qualifications, then each qualification should be submitted in a separate application. Once your Helloverify report is issued as 'positive', you can proceed to obtain the respective recognition certificate from MOHESR.

items.question: How long does the Degree Verification process usually take?
items.answer:
The verification process is usually done **within 18 Calendar days** after you submit all the required documents and information. The actual turnaround time can depend on the responsiveness of your university.
If we anticipate any delays due to unavoidable circumstances or a need for further information, we will contact you immediately. To prevent delays, please ensure you submit accurate documents with your initial application.

items.question: How can I get a copy of my Helloverify Degree Verification Report?
items.answer: You will be notified by email once your verification is successfully completed. After receiving this notification, you can log back into the Helloverify application portal to download a copy of your verification certificate.

items.question: What happens once my application is completed?
items.answer: Once your degree verification is successfully completed, you should go to the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHESR) portal to proceed with the second stage and obtain your official Certificate of Recognition.

items.question: I have made a mistake in my application. Can I make changes to it?
items.answer:
Before Payment: If you have not yet paid for the verification, you can make the edits and corrections required directly on the Helloverify portal yourself.
After Payment: If you need to make corrections after submitting and paying for your application, please connect to Helloverify support By Emailing at MOHESR@helloverify.ae.

items.question: What should I do if I encounter technical issues while uploading my documents?
items.answer:
1. Ensure all documents are uploaded in either **PDF, JPG, PNG, HEIC or JPEG format**.
2. Each document file size should **not exceed 10MB**.
3. Verify that you have completed all fields marked with a (*).
4. If technical issues persist, please email us directly at MOHESR@helloverify.ae or techsupport@helloverify.ae.
